headline: From Flat File to Live Platform
subheadline: Allocate is designed for fast deployment with no IT integration required.

onboarding.title: How Onboarding Works
onboarding.description: Allocate ingests the flat files your institution already knows how to export — CSV exports from your SIS, ERP, or billing system. No API integration, no IT security review for direct system access, no months-long implementation project.

steps.title: Export Your Data
steps.description: Pull standard CSV exports from the systems you already use. We provide templates that map to common SIS and ERP export formats.

steps.title: Configure Your Institution
steps.description: We set up your institutional parameters — room inventory, scheduling constraints, policy rules, and compliance requirements — during a guided onboarding session.

steps.title: Go Live
steps.description: Your team starts working with the platform immediately. No training certification required — the conversational interface means administrators interact in their own language.

points.title: Modular Adoption
points.description: Start with the module that solves your most pressing problem. Add capabilities as your needs evolve — each module is independently valuable and more powerful in combination.

points.title: No Technical Expertise Required
points.description: The conversational interface translates plain-language questions into sophisticated analytical operations. Administrators interact with the platform the way they'd interact with an expert analyst.

points.title: Auditor-Grade Explainability
points.description: Every recommendation includes the reasoning behind it, the factors that drove it, and a logged audit trail. The AI advises; your team decides.

points.title: Compliance by Default
points.description: Regulatory requirements are encoded into the platform as hard constraints, not optional add-ons. The system prevents compliance violations before they happen.

cta.heading: Ready to See It in Action?
cta.description: We work with a small number of institutional partners to ensure every deployment gets the attention it deserves. If your institution is facing scheduling complexity, receivables pressure, or compliance risk, let's talk.
